description: FIRST-TOUCH baseline: the ability-only error floor U*(1-f)*(2 + 0.1*X) km/h, raised from 2 to 3 km/h by re-aiming the 2.0 operand at the existing 3.0 cell 0x1478504e8. This is the term that fires even on an easy, slow ball, so it is the one that makes a mediocre technician's SETTLED touches slightly untidy. Still zero for a Ball Control 99 player unless trap.ballControlRate < 1.0. Emulated: BC75/rate0.85 at 40 km/h relative 2.45 -> 2.66 km/h.
